_comment: Lightweight first-level filter — not the final decision. Matches here only trigger Gemini for contextual analysis; they never flag content by themselves. Update freely; no code changes needed. General profanity/curse words are NOT listed here — that's covered comprehensively by the better_profanity library's built-in dictionary (see keyword_filter.py). This file only owns things a generic profanity dictionary won't have: threat/violence/harassment phrases and mild non-swear insults.
